description: This file contains implementation of action handlers for a rule-based engine, including device control (lights, doors, thermostats), notifications (email, SMS, push), media (pictures, video, sound), and translation of rules into JavaScript. It defines functions, external references, and mappings for rule actions within a smart home or IoT system.
